subtitle: Johto badges, wild encounters and items across the multiworld
description: Randomizes Johto: badges, items, trainers and wild encounters join the multiworld. Requires your own Pokemon Crystal ROM (US 1.0 or 1.1); the seed's .apcrystal patch is applied to it.
_source_patch_extension: pokemon_crystal/rom.py: apply_bsdiff4 dispatches on AP_ROM_Revision (data.json rom_addresses=332) to basepatch11.bsdiff4; apply_overrides reads host.yaml option_overrides and is identity without them. Replicated in Core/Patching/ApPatch.cs 17/8.
